name: kaku
title: Kaku
description: Capability index for Kaku, an AI-friendly Mac terminal with sensible defaults, ready out of the box. Kaku is a local desktop application with no network API: every capability below is exercised through the local `kaku` command or the app itself, and each links to the markdown documentation that backs it.

skills.name: install-kaku
skills.description: Install Kaku on macOS and verify the installation. Use the DMG from GitHub Releases, or `brew install tw93/tap/kakuku` (the unrelated Homebrew `kaku` package is a different project). Then run `kaku doctor` to check the app bundle, config directory, PATH, zsh/fish integration, and optional tools.

skills.name: diagnose-kaku
skills.description: Diagnose a broken or misbehaving Kaku install. `kaku doctor` reports app bundle, config, PATH, shell integration, and optional tool health. If the `kaku` command is missing from the shell, run `/Applications/Kaku.app/Contents/MacOS/kaku init --update-only` then `exec zsh -l`.

skills.name: configure-ai-assistant
skills.description: Configure Kaku Assistant to draft fixes for failed commands and turn plain language into commands. `kaku ai` opens the settings panel for Auth Type (API key or Codex CLI login), Base URL, Simple Model, Deep Model, and API key. Configure your own AI service. Kaku does not provide or relay it; see the privacy page for network details.

skills.name: configure-terminal
skills.description: Change Kaku settings: font, opacity, Smart Tab, close confirmation, shortcuts, and theme. `kaku config` opens the TUI; deeper changes go in `~/.config/kaku/kaku.lua`, which uses WezTerm's Lua configuration system.

skills.name: customize-keybindings
skills.description: Look up or rebind Kaku shortcuts for windows, tabs, panes, shell editing, AI features, Lazygit, and Yazi. Append to `config.keys` in `~/.config/kaku/kaku.lua` rather than replacing it, so the defaults survive.

skills.name: script-kaku-panes
skills.description: Drive the Kaku multiplexer from scripts and external tools. `kaku cli split-pane` splits the current pane, `kaku cli split-pane -- bash -c "..."` splits and runs a command, and `kaku cli --help` lists every subcommand. Useful for wiring Kaku into AI tools and shell automation.

skills.name: chat-from-shell
skills.description: Open Kaku's AI chat from any shell with `kaku chat` (or `k`), sharing the same conversation and memory store as the in-app `Cmd + L` overlay. Supports one-shot prompts and the `/new`, `/resume`, `/clear`, `/status`, `/memory`, and `/exit` commands.

skills.name: update-or-reset-kaku
skills.description: Upgrade Kaku in place with `kaku update`, or undo Kaku's changes to the shell with `kaku reset`, which removes Kaku-managed shell and tmux integration, git delta defaults, selected state, and managed theme blocks while preserving user-authored Lua.

notApplicable: Windows and Linux: Kaku is macOS only and no date is promised.
Remote or hosted use: there is no Kaku API, SDK, MCP server, or server-side product.
Billing and accounts: Kaku is free, MIT licensed, and has no account system.
